# Lumen UI

Lumen is a multi-framework primitive UI system with Astro as the reference implementation.

Use these files first when generating, reviewing, or migrating apps that use Lumen:

- README.md: public overview and package strategy.
- docs/ai-usage.md: AI-focused setup, package selection, and component selection.
- skills/lumen-ui/SKILL.md: portable Agent Skill for building, reviewing, and theming Lumen interfaces.
- docs/feature-roadmap.md: competitor-informed gaps and implementation priorities.
- registry/lumen.registry.json: installable component, recipe, and documentation manifest.
- packages/core/src/components.ts: authoritative shared component catalog.
- packages/astro/components: reference component markup and prop shapes.
- packages/astro/styles/lumen.css: standalone CSS contract for all frameworks.
- @santi020k/lumen-mcp: Model Context Protocol server exposing snapshot provenance, structured component discovery, framework-aware usage/source, recipes, tolerant search, tokens, rules, and lumen:// resources for AI agents.

Install the portable Lumen Agent Skill:

```bash
npx skills add santi020k/lumen --skill lumen-ui
```

Default usage:

```astro
---
import { Button, Card, Input, Label } from '@santi020k/lumen-astro'
import UIPrimitives from '@santi020k/lumen-astro/runtime'
import '@santi020k/lumen-astro/styles.css'
---

<UIPrimitives />
<Card>
  <Label for="email">Email</Label>
  <Input id="email" type="email" />
  <Button>Subscribe</Button>
</Card>
```

Rules for agents:

- When Lumen MCP is connected, read `lumen://meta`, `lumen://diagnostics`, and `lumen://rules`, pass the target framework to `lumen_search`, and follow the framework behavior returned by `lumen_get_component`. Retain `lumen://catalog-manifest` and use `lumen_diff_catalog` after upgrades when the client supports cached context.
- Prefer Astro unless the user explicitly targets React or Web Components.
- In React, use the visual components with behavior hooks for Dialog, Popover, DropdownMenu, Tabs, Select, Toast, and Tooltip instead of mounting the Astro runtime.
- In Web Components, registered `lumen-*` elements include behavior parity for Dialog, Popover, DropdownMenu, Tabs, Select, Toast, and Tooltip, including ARIA state, keyboard paths, Escape/outside dismissal, focus handling, native select form participation, and the shared toast controller.
- For React report filters, use `DateRangeInput` (`value`, `onValueChange`, localized `labels`, bounds and presets) or inline `DateRangeCalendar`. These React-specific compositions are documented in packages/react/README.md and the reporting example at /docs/web/reporting.
- Keep server-paginated DataTable rows in server order with `sortMode="manual"`, controlled `sort` and `onSortChange`. Apply sorting before pagination in the application backend. Use Dialog dismissal policies for pending workflows.
- Chart X identities must be unique. Use `xLabel` for abbreviated axes, `formatCategory` for full details, and explicit null gaps for missing observations. Read docs/data-visualization.md.
- Use ImageComparison for before/after media with matching dimensions, alternative text and a visible localized control label. See docs/image-comparison.md for adapter contracts.
- Read docs/migrating-to-lumen.md before upgrading to v4, especially date-trigger IDs, loading buttons, hidden semantics, copy feedback and native initializer changes.
- Do not require Tailwind configuration for Lumen components.
- Give each outer edge one border and radius owner. Flush images inside rounded frames use Image radius="none"; Image defaults to radius="lg". Use one divider at shared edges, account for padding on inset curves, and check phone/desktop corners and keyboard focus in both themes. Keep artwork clipping scoped so it does not cut off focus rings or overlays. See docs/ai-usage.md for styling rules.
- Use public tokens: canvas, surface, surface-muted, surface-strong, line, ink, ink-soft, ink-muted, brand, brand-solid, brand-soft, on-brand, accent, success, warning, danger, on-danger.
- Mount `UIPrimitives` once for interactive Astro primitives.
- Use `glass` for glass surfaces. The obsolete overlay `surface="glass"` alias is removed.
- Treat schedule, data collection, rich text, theme builder, and advanced fields as supported surfaces with progressively enhanced behavior.
- Use `lumen list`, `lumen show <component>`, and `lumen add <component>` for individually addressable registry components; component names also resolve from kebab-case aliases such as `data-table`.
- Runtime CustomEvents used by `UIPrimitives`: `ui:data-table-selection-change` from `[data-ui-datatable]` with `{ values }`; `ui:schedule-change` from `[data-ui-schedule]` with `{ eventId, slot }`; `ui:virtual-list-range` from `[data-ui-virtual-list]` with `{ startIndex, endIndex }`; `ui:tag-remove` from tag groups with `{ value }`; `ui:editor-command` from rich text editors with `{ command }`; `ui:theme-change` from theme builders with `{ hue, tokens }`; `ui:theme-export` from theme builders with `{ css }`; `ui:validate`, `ui:invalid`, and `ui:valid` from `[data-ui-form]` for native Constraint Validation API enhancement; document-level `ui:toast`, `ui:toast-update`, and `ui:toast-dismiss` for runtime toasts; `ui:toast-action` from `[data-ui-toast]` when an action button is pressed.
- Add `data-ui-form` to forms that should reflect `required`, `pattern`, `min`, `max`, `type`, and custom `setCustomValidity()` state into Field error slots on blur and submit. Use `data-error-required`, `data-error-pattern`, `data-error-min`, `data-error-max`, or `data-error-custom` to override browser validation messages.
- Toasts use `ToastViewport` for explicit `placement` and `maxCount` configuration. With `UIPrimitives` or registered Web Components, use `window.LumenToast.create(detail)`, `.update(id, detail)`, and `.dismiss(id?)`, import `LumenToast` from `@santi020k/lumen-elements`, or dispatch the matching document events. Runtime toast `detail` supports `title`, `description`, `variant`, `duration`, `placement`, `max`, and `action`.
